podcast.title: Mid-Decade Punk Revival Style
podcast.body: Garage Punk was identified as a key style categorizing the mid-decade punk revival of the 2010s, alongside Post Punk. This revival, possibly influenced by political events, represented a diverse range of approaches from bands like Against Me!, Sleater-Kinney, Japandroids, Fucked Up, Parquet Courts, Idles, and Sleaford Mods, building on previous punk eras. "If there's a way to categorize that mid-decade revival in Punk, it would perhaps be Garage Punk and Post Punk."
